_comment: WHAT THIS MEASURES, and what it cannot.
The page served here carries the SEEDED PLACEHOLDER GLB — about 10 KB. A real
garment is 8-40 MB. So this run says nothing whatsoever about how heavy a
production page is, and a green badge must never be read that way. The budget
that applies to real models is enforced where they actually pass through:
SIZE_WARNING_BYTES in the shrink report the owner reads, and GLB_HARD_MAX_BYTES
in the CMS upload guard.
What this job DOES protect is the application shell — scripts, CSS, fonts —
which is byte-for-byte the same in production as it is here. So the budgets
below are scoped to exactly that, and `total-byte-weight` was removed: it
conflated the shell with the model and made a 2.1 MB ceiling look like a
statement about the live page.
The category scores stay `warn`. They swung 0.64 / 0.88 / 0.87 across three
local runs of the identical build on 2026-08-01 — 24 points of noise — so
gating on them would block releases at random. The byte budgets are
deterministic and are therefore the parts that fail the build.
MEASURED 2026-08-03 on the committed build, transfer sizes, identical across
all three runs:
stylesheet     20,583 B   budget    30,000  (+46%)
The headroom is deliberately small. A first draft of these used 400 KB and
120 KB — 3.5x and 6x the real figures — which would have passed through any
regression short of a catastrophe and told nobody anything. CSS gets the
loosest ratio because a genuine design change moves it most.
CHANGED 2026-09-24 BY THE OWNER'S DECISION: the website's menu bar on the viewer. Stylesheet transfer measured 29,664 -> 34,539 B (lhci, three identical runs); budget 30,000 -> 34,875.

CHANGED 2026-09-27 FOR THE HD IMAGE BUTTON (owner-approved garment-rollout plan). The dialog's styles load WITH the lazy dialog (apps/viewer/src/styles/hd-image.css), never with the page; only the button's own rules are on it. Measured: page stylesheet 33,836 -> 34,144 B raw (+308); CI's transfer is raw + 1,019 B (PR #77: 37,505 measured for a 36,486 B file), so main measures 34,855 and this 35,163. Budget 34,875 -> 35,183: exactly the growth, the 20 B headroom unchanged.

CHANGED 2026-09-28 FOR TY-02 (owner decision: publish the three garments whose names re-wrapped). The product name gets local() stand-in faces in page.css. Measured by building with and without them: page stylesheet 34,144 -> 34,788 B raw (+644). Budget 35,183 -> 35,827: exactly the growth, the 20 B headroom unchanged.

CHANGED 2026-09-28 FOR THE DOMAIN MOVE (owner decision: garment pages on wear-run.com). No CSS changed: this budget reads TRANSFER size, headers included, and the viewer's CSP (sent on every response, the stylesheet's too) now names the media bucket's wear-run.com address in img-src and connect-src — apps/viewer/scripts/csp.mjs ZONE, ' https://media.wear-run.com' = 27 B, twice = 54 B. Measured in CI: 35,861 against 35,827 = 54 over the budget less its 20 B headroom. Budget 35,827 -> 35,881: exactly the growth, the 20 B headroom unchanged.

CHANGED 2026-09-30 FOR THE COOKIE CHOICE (owner decision: Google Analytics and Apollo on every page, garment pages too, behind a question shown to everyone). Two parts, both measured. The card's styles in packages/ui/src/base.css: page stylesheet 34,788 -> 35,571 B raw (+783); they cannot load lazily as the HD dialog's do, because the card is on screen at first paint for every new visitor. And the policy header, sent with the stylesheet too, now names the two trackers' hosts (apps/viewer/scripts/csp.mjs TRACKER_SCRIPT + TRACKER_CONNECT + TRACKER_IMG, each with its space = 58 + 115 + 62 = 235 B). Measured in CI on PR #99: 36,879 against 35,881 = 1,018 over the budget less its 20 B headroom, and 783 + 235 = 1,018. Budget 35,881 -> 36,899: exactly the growth, the 20 B headroom unchanged.

CHANGED 2026-10-01 FOR THE VISUAL AUDIT FIXES (owner-approved roadmap, one PR). The cookie card keeps keyboard focus clear of itself (a bottom reserve while it shows, a one-row card on short screens, its own focus ring) in packages/ui/src/base.css, and apps/viewer/src/styles/page.css gains 12px colour names, 44px footer links and spec notes that stay in their corners. Measured by building with main’s two files and then this branch’s: page stylesheet 35,571 -> 36,533 B raw (+962, with the sideways-phone bar rule in notch.css and --header-h derived from it in tokens.css); main’s 35,571 matches the 2026-09-30 figure above to the byte. The policy header is unchanged. CI measured 37,841 = 36,533 + the same 1,308 B of headers main carries. Budget 36,899 -> 37,861: exactly the growth, the 20 B headroom unchanged. (A first cut said +891 / 37,790, measured before those two rules; CI failed it by 51 B.)

CHANGED 2026-10-02 FOR THE SECOND VISUAL AUDIT (owner-approved, one PR; the owner chose on 2026-10-01 to raise this ONCE at the end by the measured growth, and approved the figure on 2026-10-02). Measured by building origin/main (d6f446f8) and this branch in turn: page stylesheet 36,533 -> 55,231 B raw (+18,698); main's 36,533 matches the 2026-10-01 figure above to the byte. Most of it is the website's footer, now on the garment pages too (packages/ui/src/footer.css, VA-31, 11,277 B minified on its own), then the bar and its phone menu in notch.css (+2,948) and page.css (+2,386, net of the old footer it lost). The policy header is unchanged (the built _headers is 9,612 B on both). Expected in CI: 55,231 + the same 1,308 B of headers = 56,539. Budget 37,861 -> 56,559: exactly the growth, the 20 B headroom unchanged.
